title: Toadly's PVP Modpack
description: An optimized Minecraft Fabric modpack built for high-performance PVP combat.
body:
# ⚔️ Toadly's PVP Modpack

Welcome to Toadly's PVP Modpack, the ultimate performance-focused modpack designed to give you the competitive edge in Minecraft player-versus-player combat. Built for speed, precision, and clarity, this pack removes the clutter and optimizes your game so you can focus entirely on winning your next fight.

## 🚀 Key Features

* **FPS Boost & Optimization**: Pre-configured with the industry's best optimization mods to maximize your frames per second and eliminate lag spikes.
* **Zero Display Delay**: Drastically reduces input lag so your clicks, hits, and movements register instantly.
* **Enhanced PVP Visuals**: Clean, non-intrusive visuals that maximize your field of view (FOV) and keep your targets clear.
* **Fluid Animations**: Smoother player and item animations to help you track enemy movements perfectly.

## 📦 What's Inside?

This pack carefully selects and tunes essential mods to build the ultimate lightweight PVP environment:
1. **Performance Engines**: Mods like Sodium and Lithium to squeeze every drop of performance out of your hardware.
2. **HUD Customization**: Clean, adjustable on-screen displays for your armor durability, potion effects, and keystrokes.
3. **Visual Fixes**: Features that clean up particle clutter and improve lighting in dark environments.

## 🔧 Installation & Requirements

* **Mod Loader**: Fabric
